Name: Asters Bathroom Replaces Spouseroom (with bachelor mode)
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[center]


Several bathroom designs that replace the spouseroom
If you [i]don't[/i] want to replace the spouseroom see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12404]Asters Bathroom Extension[/url]﻿ instead

Optional config that lets you have a bathroom and kitchen in the starter farmhouse
now with bachelor mode (aka "I can be single and still have a bathroom" mode)



I do art commissions! Message me on nexus, discord, or see [url=https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart]https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart[/url]. You can also follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/AsteriskArt555]twitter[/url][/center]


[u]Quick start:[/u]
[list]
[*]For the Content Patcher version you need version ﻿﻿1.19 of CP﻿ or higher
[*]Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿﻿)
[*]Choose which design you want in the config.json (there is a visual guide in the mod folder)
[*]it's ready to play!
[/list]

[u]Config guide:[/u]

[b]Keep the frogs:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Available options: true, false
[*]Lets you keep frogs in your bathroom if someone offers them to you
[/list]
[b] ﻿Manual Spouseroom Selection:[/b]
[list]
[*]Available options: Abigail, Alex, Elliott, Emily, Haley, Harvey, Leah, Maru, Penny, Sam, Sebastian, Shane, Krobus
[*]For multiple spouse compatibility, choose which person's room you want to replace with the bathroom
[/list]
[b]Decoration Style:[/b] Choose bathroom design
[list]
[*]Available options: 1,2,3,4,7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14
[*]See the "Decoration Style guide" folder inside the mod for pictures
[/list]
[b]Bachelor pad mode: [/b][list]
[*]Available options: true, false
[*]Lets you have the bathroom in the starter farmhouse
[*]Let's you have the bathroom even when you're not living with someone
[*]Can be used even if you still plan on marrying someone later
[*]Use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12120]No built in kitchen[/url] if you want the bathroom but not the kitchen in the starter farmhouse
[/list]

[u]Compatibility:[/u] 
[b]
﻿Modded farmhouses[/b]
[list]
[*]Should be compatible with the spouse room replacement
[*]Most modded farmhouses will have compatibility issues with bachelor mode and the starter farmhouse bathroom (so switch these off in the config)
[/list]
[b] ﻿Multiple spouses[/b][list]
[*]General compatibility with recolours, interior recolours, and with kitchen and general farmhouse tile sheet retextures because this mod has its own just for the bathroom only
[/list]
[b] ﻿Android
[/b][list]
[*]Not compatible
[/list]
[b] ﻿Mods with built-in compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12120]No built in kitchen[/url]
[/list]
[u]Matching Furniture Mods:[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12187]Vanilla Spouse Furniture[/url] if you still want the spouse room furniture that got removed﻿
[*]The Statue used in the fountain is by Wabi, and is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11555]Ornamental Garden Furniture[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10982]Adorable Cottage Bathroom Furniture[/url]
[*]Japanese Furniture Mod (in development)﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12137]PortaPool[/url], for if you just want to build your own bath in-game﻿
[/list]

[u]To uninstall:[/u]
[list]
[*]Just remove the mod; Depending on your config some items may end up in the void, but they shouldn't be hard to retrieve using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClip[/url].﻿
[/list]

[u]For mod authors:[/u]
[list]
[*]For built in compatibility for modded farmhouses see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12404]Asters Bathroom Extension[/url]﻿
[*]This mod loads it's tilesheets so you can also make [CP] recolours for it
[*]I can try making compat with custom NPCs if the author requests it, my guess is you'll either need to have loaded your SpouseRoom using CP or have a "hasmod" condition that switches off the spouseroom when a user has this mod. Or give permission for users to replace the spouseroom.TMX in your mod with one from this mod, with the tilesheets of course.
[/list][u]

Art Credits:[/u]
[list]
[*]The painting in the galaxy themed bathroom is by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/108217533]AuraTheFox[/url]﻿
[*]The Statue used in the fountain is by Wabi, and is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11555]Ornamental Garden Furniture[/url]﻿
[/list]
